arms_at_sides.description: Arms hanging loose at her sides. Relaxed, open, or maybe just spaced out.

folded_hands.description: Hands clasped together in front of her. Demure, careful, or maybe just shy.

hand_on_hip.description: One hand cocked on her hip, the other arm loose. Self-assured, sassy, or maybe just aloof.

hands_on_hips.description: Both hands planted on her hips, elbows out. Bold, commanding, or maybe just silly.

crossed_arms.description: Arms folded across her chest. Closed off, defensive, or maybe just confident.

clutching_arm.description: One hand gripping her own opposite arm. Nervous, self-soothing, or maybe just creepy.

one_arm_crossed_other_up.description: One arm braced under her chest, the other hand raised near her face. Theatrical, thoughtful, or maybe just a worrier.

hand_on_chest.description: One hand resting over her heart. Earnest, easygoing, or maybe just arrogant.

bold.description: Standing with legs apart and arms at her sides. Assertive, poised, or maybe just rude.

hands_behind_back.description: Hip cocked and hands hidden behind her back. Playful, coy, or maybe a little mysterious.
